title: University of Juba students protest access restrictions
notes: Eye Radio reports a peaceful student demonstration against access restrictions in October 2020; it gives no participant count. The Radio Tamazuj page metadata is from 27 October 2020, but its full body was not relied on. December 2020 and February 2021 searches did not identify a physical continuation into January; this bounded search does not establish that none occurred.

title: Juba water suppliers protest against imposed prices
notes: The report describes water suppliers downing tools in November 2020. It provides no evidence of a January 2021 continuation and does not establish a gathering of at least 50 people.

title: Sudanese protests over bread and fuel prices
notes: The reported crowds were in Khartoum and other locations in Sudan. The article does not report a South Sudan event.

title: Displaced people demonstrate against Makal county decision in Malakal
notes: The Arabic report describes a Malakal camp demonstration against a South Sudan government decision, but it is dated March 2021 and states no turnout. It is not evidence of a January continuation; translation has not had human review.

title: Threatened Juba power cutoff and online consumer complaints
notes: The January reports describe a threatened power shutdown, complaints on social media, and a government-company deal that averted the cutoff. None reports an in-person public assembly or participant count.

title: Peace delegates and hotels’ unpaid-accommodation dispute
notes: One report says delegates were locked in their accommodation; another says hotels sent a payment demand and threatened eviction. The retrieved reports describe confinement, correspondence, and a private accommodation dispute, not a public protest or participant crowd.

title: Truck drivers’ strike over highway killings
notes: Eye Radio reports an April 2021 cross-border truck-driver strike that ended after a security agreement. Hundreds of trucks were reported stuck, but trucks are not a driver count; no January continuity is described.

title: Juba protest over health-service deaths
notes: Eye Radio reports a Juba gathering at Mobil roundabout earlier in the week before its March 31 publication, with demands about government health services and 22 people later released from detention. The article provides no overall crowd count and is outside January.
